title.rendered: Supply List and Save the Date 8/25 for our Meet & Greet/Supply Night

content.rendered:
Save the date, August 25th, 4:00-6:00 pm to come and meet your student’s teacher and see their classroom for the new school year. This meet and greet night is a chance for all families to visit the school, meet their teacher, see the classroom and drop off their school supplies prior to the first day of school on Wednesday, August 27th.

Following are the supply lists for the upcoming 2025-2026 school year:

​Supply List – English

Lista de Utiles Escolares – Espanol
